name: Cavli Hubble Platform
tagline: One dashboard for every connected device
description: Cavli's IoT connectivity and module management platform. Centralized device management, real-time monitoring, remote DFOTA updates, eSIM provisioning, subscription management and detailed analytics for C-Series modules.

name: CQM220
description: 3GPP Release 17 5G RedCap module with up to 220 Mbps downlink and 120 Mbps uplink, LTE Cat 4 fallback and optional GNSS. Available in LGA and M.2 form factors with an OpenWrt-based OpenSDK. Suited to asset tracking, vehicular telemetry and Industry 4.0.

name: CQM211
description: 5G NR module in LGA and M.2 form factors, built for smart cities, industrial automation and surveillance deployments that need high data rates.

name: CQ20
description: LTE Cat 4 C-Series module for advanced IoT applications that need robust connectivity and high bandwidth, managed through Cavli Hubble.

name: C20QM
tagline: LTE Cat 4 for demanding IoT applications
description: LTE Cat 4 C-Series module designed for high-bandwidth IoT use cases, with integrated eSIM options and global multi-band support.

name: C10QM
tagline: LTE Cat 1 balance of speed and power
description: LTE Cat 1 C-Series module that balances performance with power efficiency, supporting a wide range of IoT applications and simple integration.

name: CQ16
description: LTE Cat 1bis module with single-antenna efficiency and low-power cellular connectivity, used by OEMs to retrofit legacy water and energy meters.

name: C16QS
description: LTE Cat 1bis C-Series module offering a lower-cost single-antenna option. Supported by the C-Series evaluation kit and Cavli Hubble.

name: C41QS
description: NB2/NB1 module compatible with 3GPP Release 14, in a 17.7 x 15.8 x 2.0 mm form factor. Optional integrated GNSS and eSIM, with PSM and eDRX power saving for battery-powered smart metering, parking and sensor applications.

name: AQ62
description: Automotive-series module built to IATF 16949:2016 standards for vehicle communication, telematics and connected-vehicle systems.
